body: This 2024 Ford Transit 148 EXT in our Olympus Tier was built with comfort, pets, and long road trips in mind. It features a powerful 800Ah lithium system, solar, undermount A/C, gasoline heat, a full kitchen, tiled shower, Starlink, and a custom cat-friendly layout with built-in cat walk shelves and a hidden litter box area. With warm wood finishes, Green Onyx cabinetry, and upgraded exterior gear, this Transit is made to feel like a cozy home on wheels.
